volumes.title: Volumes
volumes.noData: Load data to measure it inside volumes. Volumes can be drawn and saved already.
volumes.tool.boxTitle: Drag a rectangle on the ground (Shift: square). A click places a default box.
volumes.tool.ngonTitle: Drag from the centre out (Shift: regular). Set the corners below.
volumes.tool.polygonTitle: Click its points; double-click, Enter or a click on the first point closes it
volumes.tool.cylinderTitle: Drag from the centre out for the radius
volumes.tool.sphereTitle: Drag from the centre out for the radius; it rests on the ground
volumes.hint.box: Drag on the ground to draw the box. Esc cancels.
volumes.hint.ngon: Drag from the centre out; Shift keeps it regular. Esc cancels.
volumes.hint.polygon: Click the points on the ground. Double-click, Enter or the first point closes; Backspace removes the last; Esc cancels.
volumes.hint.cylinder: Drag from the centre out. Esc cancels.
volumes.hint.sphere: Drag from the centre out. Esc cancels.
volumes.hint.start: Pick a shape, then drag on the ground in the view or on the 2D map. Heights come from the data under it.
volumes.hint.edit: Click a volume to select it. Drag its body to move, the corners and points to reshape (Shift on a point: scale), the yellow handles for floor and ceiling, the cyan one to turn. Alt+drag: copy. Del removes, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo, Ctrl+D duplicates.
volumes.filter.offTitle: The volumes measure, they do not filter
volumes.filter.insideTitle: Draw only the data inside the volumes (included and not excluded), in the heatmap, the replay and the hit analysis
volumes.filter.outsideTitle: Draw everything but the data inside the volumes
volumes.row.opTitle: Include: its data is selected. Exclude: its data is cut out of the selection.
volumes.row.droppedTitle: Not applied to the heat filter: at most 8 volumes and 64 outline points in all reach the GPU. Statistics and export still count it.
volumes.io.imported: {count, plural, one {# volume loaded} other {# volumes loaded}}
volumes.stats.title: Statistics
volumes.stats.liftTitle: Share inside divided by the share in all shown data: above 1 means over-represented inside
volumes.stats.more: {count, plural, one {# more value} other {# more values}}
volumes.export.title: Export the data inside
volumes.export.shownOnlyTitle: Respect the filters and the time window; off exports every row inside
volumes.export.allTitle: The rows the volumes select together (included, not excluded), every column, plus which volume holds each row
